Mode: chrome: reflection blended over the colour. glass: refracted colour behind the surface mixed with the reflection.
Reflectivity: Reflection weight (0-1) when Fresnel is 0. 1 = mirror.
Fresnel: 0 = constant Reflectivity. 1 = Schlick fresnel from Ior, so reflection is strongest at grazing edges.
Roughness: Blurs the environment lookup (0-1). 0 = sharp mirror, higher = frosted. Scaled by the mask when Maskmode is roughness.
Ior: Index of refraction (1 = none, 1.5 = glass). Sets Fresnel strength and how much glass bends the view.
Refraction: Glass mode: screen-space offset of the colour behind the surface. 0 = no bend.
Maskmode: How in4 (R) is used. roughness: scales Roughness. reflectivity: scales reflection weight. off: ignore in4.
Normalenc: Encoding of the in2 normals. signed: XYZ in -1..1. packed: 0..1 values decoded as n*2-1.
Fov: Vertical camera field of view in degrees for per-pixel view rays. 0 = orthographic (parallel rays).
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Envrotate: Rotates the environment map around the vertical axis, in degrees.
Envtilt: Tilts the environment map up/down, in degrees.
Envgain: Brightness multiplier for the environment map. 1 = unchanged.
Tint: Colour multiplied into the reflection (in glass mode, also the transmitted colour).
